title: Readdy ambassador pitch: build a $1,000 client website overnight with the Readdy AI site builder

tools.name: Readdy
tools.detail: AI website builder; describe the business/vibe, it generates design, copy, layout, animated sections; edit in plain language. Hashtag #readdyambassador = affiliate

claims: Built a full client website using only AI for $1,000 in one night
Readdy builds a full professional responsive site in minutes from a description
No plugins, no scraping other sites' code, no piecing together five tools
Includes animated sections/effects 'you normally need a real designer for'
Customisation done in plain language; no code, no drag-and-drop
how_to_steps: Go to Readdy and describe the client's business, what they do, and the vibe
Let Readdy generate the full site (design, copy, layout, animations)
Customise in plain language: swap images, tighten copy, match client brand
Fine-tune a few things afterward; deliver to client
on_screen_only: Overlay title: 'i built a website for my client in one day and it made me $1000'
Laptop showing a nail-salon landing page with hero headline 'Your nails, sky-high beautiful' (the demo site)

relevance.why: Affiliate pitch for a no-code site builder; founder already builds with Claude Code and has no need for a locked-in hosted builder.

implement_score.why: Nothing to implement. If anything, confirms that AI-built client sites are a commoditised $1k service; not a differentiator.

verify: Is Readdy a real, maintained product and what does hosting/export cost?
Is the $1,000 in one night claim an ambassador script rather than a real engagement?
Can Readdy sites be exported/self-hosted or is the client locked in?
